prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic cinematic close-up portrait of an adult woman with soft brown hair and natural makeup, centered in symmetrical framing against a dark minimal background. A dramatic horizontal strip of warm golden sunset light illuminates only her eyes while the lower half of her face falls into cool teal shadow; keep half of her face in deep shadow. She holds intense direct eye contact with an emotional, contemplative expression. Use high-contrast low-key lighting, a volumetric light-beam effect, soft glow on realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, an 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8, and teal-and-orange cinematic grading.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. An optional approved-adult face reference may be attached; preserve face, facial structure, likeness, direct eye contact, hair, centered crop, and the golden eye-light band. The wardrobe and background may be replaced without changing the lighting geometry.
